title: Equitable Electronic Health Record Prediction with FAME: Fairness-Aware Multimodal Embedding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model fairness by computing the Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) and Equalized Odds (EO) across five racial/ethnic subgroups (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, Other) to measure differences in prediction error rates, true positive rates, and false positive rates.

Using patient insurance type (Medicare, Private, Medicaid, Government, Self Pay) as a proxy for socioeconomic status, and measuring fairness through the Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) and Equalized Odds (EO) to detect disparities in clinical prediction performance.

Assessing predictive disparities by calculating the Error Distribution Disparity Index (EDDI) and Equalized Odds (EO) based on error rates and performance gaps across distinct patient age brackets (15-29, 30-49, 50-69, 70+).
